All Python code: VD3-GNP extension model, NUP analysis and business study

Companion code for the extension of Roy & Hussain, Int J Mol Sci 2024;25(10):5348. Put the files in one folder (the zip uses a vd3gnp/ subfolder), then run pip install numpy scipy pandas scikit-learn matplotlib openpyxl and python run_all.py outputs.

Simulated data are labelled as such in the code and outputs; business inputs are illustrative placeholders. Each file has Copy and Download buttons.

run_all.py

Runs every script and writes all outputs

"""Run everything: python run_all.py [output_dir]"""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
out = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "outputs"; os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
import business_report, nup_report, charts
m, mc = business_report.build(f"{out}/Business_Cost_Study.xlsx", f"{out}/charts")
nup_report.build(f"{out}/NUP_Autophagy_Correlation.xlsx", f"{out}/charts")
charts.build(f"{out}/charts")
import subprocess
for script in ("nuclear_pore_workbook.py", "paper_extension_workbook.py"):
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), script)], check=True, env={**os.environ, "OUT_DIR": out})
print("done")

science.py

Published values, pathway calibration, simulated replicates and 120-patient cohort, regression and classifier

import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

CAP=0.95
ENDP=["PI3K","AKT","p-AKT (Ser473)","mTOR","ETV7","p-YAP (Ser127)","YAP","TAZ"]
MDA_RAW=[63.14,75,73.73,65.34,37,59.6,48.93,68.12]
MDA_SIG=["p<0.001","ns","p<0.05","ns","ns","p<0.05","p<0.05","p<0.05"]
MCF_RAW=[78.3,47,66.3,214.4,109.4,39.11,22.86,29.53]
MCF_SIG=["p<0.05","ns","ns","ns","p<0.01","p<0.05","ns","p<0.05"]
W=[1/6,0,1/6,1/6,1/6,0,1/6,1/6]   # PI3K, p-AKT, mTOR, ETV7, YAP, TAZ
def capped(raw): return [min(r/100,CAP) for r in raw]
def composite(raw):
    c=capped(raw); return float(np.exp(sum(w*np.log(1-x) for w,x in zip(W,c))))
COMP={"TNBC":composite(MDA_RAW),"ER+":composite(MCF_RAW)}
RED={"TNBC":dict(zip(ENDP,capped(MDA_RAW))),"ER+":dict(zip(ENDP,capped(MCF_RAW)))}
SHRINK=0.5; COUP=0.6; THR=-0.30; SDN=0.25

def replicates(seed=21):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed); out=[]
    for line,raw in (("MDA-MB-231",MDA_RAW),("MCF-7",MCF_RAW)):
        for e,c in zip(ENDP,capped(raw)):
            ctrl=np.exp(rng.normal(0,0.12,3)); ctrl=ctrl/ctrl.mean()*np.exp(rng.normal(0,0.03))
            trt=(1-c)*np.exp(rng.normal(0,0.18,3))
            out.append((line,e,[round(float(x),3) for x in ctrl],[round(float(x),3) for x in trt]))
    return out

def cohort(seed=5):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed); rows=[]; pid=0
    for sub in ("ER+","TNBC"):
        for arm in ("Placebo","VD3-GNP"):
            for _ in range(30):
                pid+=1
                age=rng.normal(55,10); bmi=rng.normal(28,5); d=max(6,rng.normal(24,8))
                etv=max(20,rng.normal(150+(15 if sub=="TNBC" else 0),40)); pak=max(20,rng.normal(140,40))
                yap=min(95,max(8,rng.normal(40+(8 if sub=="TNBC" else 0),12))); ki=max(3,rng.normal(28 if sub=="TNBC" else 18,9))
                m=1+0.02*(24-d)/1.0*0.5 if arm=="VD3-GNP" else 0   # lower baseline 25OHD -> slightly larger effect
                f={"ETV7":SHRINK*RED[sub]["ETV7"],"pAKT":SHRINK*RED[sub]["p-AKT (Ser473)"],"YAP":SHRINK*RED[sub]["YAP"],
                   "Ki67":COUP*SHRINK*(1-COMP[sub])}
                z=rng.normal(0,0.10)
                dl={}
                for k in ("ETV7","pAKT","YAP"):
                    base=(-f[k]*m) if arm=="VD3-GNP" else -0.01
                    dl[k]=base+z+rng.normal(0,SDN*0.8)
                kbase=(-f["Ki67"]*m) if arm=="VD3-GNP" else -0.02
                dl["Ki67"]=kbase+0.30*(dl["ETV7"]-(-f["ETV7"]*m if arm=="VD3-GNP" else -0.01))+0.25*(dl["pAKT"]-(-f["pAKT"]*m if arm=="VD3-GNP" else -0.01))+rng.normal(0,SDN*0.9)
                post={k:v for k,v in dl.items()}
                ca=rng.normal(9.4,0.4); ca2=ca+rng.normal(0.03 if arm=="VD3-GNP" else 0,0.25)
                rows.append(dict(id=f"P{pid:03d}",sub=sub,arm=arm,age=age,bmi=bmi,d=d,
                    etv0=etv,etv1=max(1,etv*(1+post["ETV7"])),pak0=pak,pak1=max(1,pak*(1+post["pAKT"])),
                    yap0=yap,yap1=min(100,max(1,yap*(1+post["YAP"]))),ki0=ki,ki1=max(0.5,ki*(1+post["Ki67"])),ca0=ca,ca1=ca2))
    return rows

def analyses(rows):
    d=np.array
    ki=d([(r['ki1']-r['ki0'])/r['ki0'] for r in rows])
    arm=d([1 if r['arm']=="VD3-GNP" else 0 for r in rows]); tn=d([1 if r['sub']=="TNBC" else 0 for r in rows])
    age=d([r['age'] for r in rows]); bmi=d([r['bmi'] for r in rows]); vd=d([r['d'] for r in rows]); k0=d([r['ki0'] for r in rows])
    X=np.column_stack([np.ones(len(rows)),arm,tn,arm*tn,vd,age,bmi,k0]); names=["Intercept","VD3-GNP (vs placebo)","TNBC (vs ER+)","VD3-GNP x TNBC","Baseline 25(OH)D (ng/mL)","Age (years)","BMI (kg/m2)","Baseline Ki-67 (%)"]
    beta,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,ki,rcond=None); res=ki-X@beta; n,p=X.shape; s2=res@res/(n-p)
    se=np.sqrt(np.diag(s2*np.linalg.inv(X.T@X))); t=beta/se; pv=2*stats.t.sf(abs(t),n-p); tc=stats.t.ppf(0.975,n-p)
    ols=[(nm,b,s,tt,pp,b-tc*s,b+tc*s) for nm,b,s,tt,pp in zip(names,beta,se,t,pv)]
    r2=1-(res@res)/((ki-ki.mean())@(ki-ki.mean()))
    # logistic
    y=(ki<=THR).astype(int)
    F=np.column_stack([arm,tn,vd,[r['etv0'] for r in rows],[r['pak0'] for r in rows],[r['yap0'] for r in rows],k0,age,bmi])
    fn=["VD3-GNP arm","TNBC subtype","Baseline 25(OH)D","Baseline ETV7 H-score","Baseline p-AKT H-score","Baseline YAP nuclear %","Baseline Ki-67 %","Age","BMI"]
    idx=np.random.default_rng(2).permutation(len(rows)); te=idx[:36]; tr=idx[36:]
    sc=StandardScaler().fit(F[tr]); lr=LogisticRegression(C=1.0,max_iter=500).fit(sc.transform(F[tr]),y[tr])
    pr=lr.predict_proba(sc.transform(F[te]))[:,1]
    lo=[(nm,float(np.exp(c))) for nm,c in zip(fn,lr.coef_[0])]
    return ols,float(r2),lo,[(rows[i]['id'],int(y[i]),float(p)) for i,p in zip(te,pr)],float(roc_auc_score(y[te],pr)),int(y.sum())

if __name__=="__main__":
    print(COMP)
    rows=cohort(); o,r2,lo,te,auc,npos=analyses(rows)
    print(r2,auc,npos,[ (a,round(b,3),round(e,4)) for a,b,s,t,e,l,u in o]); print(lo); print(sum(t[1] for t in te),len(te))

transport.py

Nuclear-pore size limit, transport kinetics, dose-response

"""Nuclear-pore transport and pathway dose-response for the Roy & Hussain (2024) VD3-GNP particle."""
import numpy as np
import science as S

P = dict(dcore=16.6, dsd=2.41, dh=34.6, comp=0.5, dnpc=39.0, dpass=5.0, kup=0.15, kesc=0.08, kdeg=0.05,
         kexp=0.02, kp0=0.30, d50=7.0, wd=1.5, kact=0.5, dt=0.5, T=48, ec50=10.0, hill=1.0, d0=38.0)

def nuclear_rate(nls, P=P):
    kp = P['kp0'] / (1 + np.exp((P['dh'] - P['d50']) / P['wd']))
    ka = nls * P['kact'] * max(0.0, 1 - P['dh'] / P['dnpc'])
    return kp + ka

def timecourse(nls, P=P):
    kn = nuclear_rate(nls, P); dt = P['dt']; n = int(P['T'] / dt)
    out = np.zeros((n + 1, 4)); out[0] = [1, 0, 0, 0]
    for i in range(n):
        E, En, C, N = out[i]
        out[i + 1] = [E - dt * P['kup'] * E,
                      En + dt * (P['kup'] * E - (P['kesc'] + P['kdeg']) * En),
                      C + dt * (P['kesc'] * En - kn * C + P['kexp'] * N),
                      N + dt * (kn * C - P['kexp'] * N)]
    return np.arange(n + 1) * dt, out

def k_pooled():
    ks = []
    for key in ("TNBC", "ER+"):
        obs = {"TNBC": 0.4838, "ER+": 0.6137}[key]
        ks.append(np.log(1 - obs) / np.log(S.COMP[key]))
    return float(np.mean(ks))

def dose_response(doses, P=P):
    k = k_pooled(); res = {}
    for key, raw in (("TNBC", S.MDA_RAW), ("ER+", S.MCF_RAW)):
        red = np.array(S.capped(raw)); w = np.array(S.W); out = []
        for d in doses:
            frac = min(1, (d**P['hill'] / (P['ec50']**P['hill'] + d**P['hill'])) / (P['d0']**P['hill'] / (P['ec50']**P['hill'] + P['d0']**P['hill'])))
            comp = float(np.exp(np.sum(w * np.log(1 - red * frac))))
            out.append(1 - comp**k)
        res[key] = out
    return res

transport_sim.py

First model: transport and RNA simulation helpers

import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

P = dict(dt=0.5, dose=0.15, lig=100, rel=0.5, kd=2.0, d50=7.0, w=1.5, dnpc=39.0, kp0=0.30, ka=0.50,
         kup=0.15, kesc=0.08, kdeg=0.05, kexp=0.02, free_occ=0.20, T=24, g0=4.0, gslope=400.0)

GENES = ["ATG7","BECN1","ATG5","ULK1","MAP1LC3B","ATG12","ATG16L1","SQSTM1","CYP24A1","CDKN1A","BAX","BCL2","MKI67","GAPDH"]
EMAX  = [-2.2,-1.5,-1.2,-1.0,-1.3,-0.8,-0.6,0.5,5.0,1.2,0.8,-0.9,-1.0,0.0]
BASE  = [1800,2400,2100,1500,3200,2600,1700,5200,35,900,1600,2300,1400,18000]
ROLE  = ["Core autophagy (E1-like; LC3 lipidation) - PRIMARY TARGET","Autophagy initiation (PI3K-III complex)","Phagophore elongation (ATG12-ATG5)",
 "Autophagy initiation kinase","Autophagosome marker (LC3B)","Conjugation (ATG12-ATG5)","Conjugation scaffold","Cargo receptor p62 (accumulates when flux blocked)",
 "Canonical VDR target (positive control)","Cell-cycle arrest (p21), VDR target","Pro-apoptotic","Anti-apoptotic","Proliferation marker","Housekeeping (no change expected)"]

def uf_rule(d):
    return 0.5+0.5/(1+np.exp(-(d-7)/1.5))

def f_nuc(d, nls, uf=None, P=P):
    uf = uf_rule(d) if uf is None else uf
    kp = P['kp0']/(1+np.exp((d-P['d50'])/P['w']))
    ka = nls*P['ka']*max(0,1-d/P['dnpc'])
    kn = kp+ka
    E,En,C,N = 1.0,0.0,0.0,0.0
    dt=P['dt']
    for _ in range(int(P['T']/dt)):
        E2 = E - dt*P['kup']*uf*E
        En2 = En + dt*(P['kup']*uf*E-(P['kesc']+P['kdeg'])*En)
        C2 = C + dt*(P['kesc']*En-kn*C+P['kexp']*N)
        N2 = N + dt*(kn*C-P['kexp']*N)
        E,En,C,N = E2,En2,C2,N2
    return N

def occ(fN, dose=None, lig=None, P=P):
    dose = P['dose'] if dose is None else dose
    lig = P['lig'] if lig is None else lig
    c = dose*lig*P['rel']*fN
    return c/(c+P['kd'])

UF={'AuNP-D3 5 nm (passive)':0.5,'AuNP-D3 15 nm (no NLS)':1.0,'AuNP-D3-NLS 15 nm':1.0}
ARMS = [("Control",None,None),("Free D3",None,None),("AuNP-D3 5 nm (passive)",5,0),("AuNP-D3 15 nm (no NLS)",15,0),("AuNP-D3-NLS 15 nm",15,1)]
def arm_occ():
    out=[]
    for n,d,nls in ARMS:
        if n=="Control": out.append(0.0)
        elif n=="Free D3": out.append(P['free_occ'])
        else: out.append(occ(f_nuc(d,nls,UF[n])))
    return out

def make_rna(seed=7):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    o=arm_occ(); counts=[]
    for g,(em,b) in enumerate(zip(EMAX,BASE)):
        row=[]
        gene_eff = rng.normal(0,0.1)  # library/gene-level offset
        for a in range(5):
            mu=b*2**(em*o[a])
            for r in range(3):
                lib=np.exp(rng.normal(0,0.08))
                disp=0.04
                m=mu*lib
                n=1/disp; p=n/(n+m)
                row.append(int(rng.negative_binomial(n,p)))
        counts.append(row)
    return np.array(counts)

THR=-1.0
def make_cls(n=800, seed=11):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    d=rng.uniform(3,40,n); nls=rng.integers(0,2,n); dose=10**rng.uniform(np.log10(0.01),np.log10(0.2),n)
    lig=rng.integers(30,201,n)
    fN=np.array([f_nuc(a,b) for a,b in zip(d,nls)])
    o=np.array([occ(f,ds,l) for f,ds,l in zip(fN,dose,lig)])
    lfc=-2.2*o+rng.normal(0,0.30,n)
    y=(lfc<=THR).astype(int)
    fm=fN*np.exp(rng.normal(0,0.15,n))
    gh=P['g0']+P['gslope']*dose*fN+rng.normal(0,1.0,n)
    X=np.column_stack([d,nls,dose,lig,fm,gh])
    return X,y

def train():
    X,y=make_cls()
    Xtr,Xte,ytr,yte=train_test_split(X,y,test_size=200,random_state=3,stratify=y)
    m=GradientBoostingClassifier(n_estimators=80,max_depth=3,learning_rate=0.08,random_state=1).fit(Xtr,ytr)
    pr=m.predict_proba(Xte)[:,1]
    return Xte,yte,pr,roc_auc_score(yte,pr),m.score(Xtr,ytr)

if __name__=="__main__":
    print("occ",arm_occ(), [f_nuc(5,0,0.5),f_nuc(15,0,1),f_nuc(15,1,1)])
    Xte,yte,pr,auc,tr=train()
    pred=(pr>=0.5).astype(int)
    tp=((pred==1)&(yte==1)).sum();fp=((pred==1)&(yte==0)).sum();fn=((pred==0)&(yte==1)).sum();tn=((pred==0)&(yte==0)).sum()
    print(tp,fn,fp,tn,"prev",yte.mean(),"auc",auc,"train acc",tr)

Builds Nuclear_Pore_VitD3_AuNP_Model.xlsx

import numpy as np
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter as L
from openpyxl.chart import LineChart, BarChart, Reference, Series
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import ColorScaleRule
import transport_sim as sim
import os
OUT=os.environ.get('OUT_DIR','outputs'); os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)

wb = Workbook()
F = "Arial"
f_norm = Font(name=F, size=10)
f_bold = Font(name=F, size=10, bold=True)
f_in   = Font(name=F, size=10, color="0000FF")
f_link = Font(name=F, size=10, color="008000")
f_hdr  = Font(name=F, size=10, bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
f_title= Font(name=F, size=14, bold=True, color="1F3A5F")
f_note = Font(name=F, size=9, italic=True, color="595959")
fill_h = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F3A5F")
fill_y = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FFFF00")
fill_s = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="E8EEF5")
thin = Side(style="thin", color="BFBFBF"); box = Border(left=thin,right=thin,top=thin,bottom=thin)
wrap = Alignment(wrap_text=True, vertical="top")

def put(ws, ref, v, font=f_norm, fmt=None, fill=None, al=None, border=True):
    c = ws[ref]; c.value = v; c.font = font
    if fmt: c.number_format = fmt
    if fill: c.fill = fill
    if al: c.alignment = al
    if border: c.border = box
    return c
def hdr(ws, row, vals, col=1):
    for i,v in enumerate(vals):
        put(ws, f"{L(col+i)}{row}", v, f_hdr, fill=fill_h, al=Alignment(wrap_text=True, horizontal="center", vertical="center"))
def title(ws, t, sub=None):
    ws["A1"].value=t; ws["A1"].font=f_title
    if sub: ws["A2"].value=sub; ws["A2"].font=f_note
def widths(ws, d):
    for k,v in d.items(): ws.column_dimensions[k].width=v

GENES, EMAX, BASE, ROLE = sim.GENES, sim.EMAX, sim.BASE, sim.ROLE
ARMN = [a[0] for a in sim.ARMS]

# ============ Parameters ============
wp = wb.active; wp.title = "Parameters"
title(wp, "Model parameters (edit blue cells; everything else recalculates)",
      "Illustrative values for a hypothetical D3-gold-nanoparticle construct in breast cancer cells (e.g. MCF-7). Not measured data.")
hdr(wp, 3, ["Parameter","Value","Unit","Basis / note"])
rows = [
 ("Simulation time step",0.5,"h","Euler step for the compartment model (keep <= 0.5 for stability)","0.0"),
 ("Nanoparticle concentration dosed",0.15,"nM","Assumed in-vitro dose","0.000"),
 ("Vitamin D3 ligands per nanoparticle",100,"count","Assumed surface loading","0"),
 ("Fraction of ligand active at nucleus",0.5,"fraction","Assumed release / accessibility to VDR","0.00"),
 ("Effective VDR binding constant (Kd)",2.0,"nM","Assumed; free calcitriol-VDR Kd is far lower (~0.1 nM), raised for conjugate","0.00"),
 ("Passive-diffusion sigmoid centre (d50)",7,"nm","NPC passive limit is ~5 nm (~40 kDa); sigmoid smooths the cut-off","0.0"),
 ("Passive-diffusion sigmoid width",1.5,"nm","Assumed","0.0"),
 ("NPC central channel max cargo diameter",39,"nm","Active (importin alpha/beta) transport limit, ~39 nm","0.0"),
 ("Max passive nuclear import rate",0.30,"1/h","Assumed","0.00"),
 ("NLS-mediated active import rate",0.50,"1/h","Assumed; scales down as cargo approaches channel limit","0.00"),
 ("Endocytic uptake rate (reference size)",0.15,"1/h","Extracellular -> endosome; scaled by arm uptake factor","0.00"),
 ("Endosomal escape rate",0.08,"1/h","Endosome -> cytosol","0.00"),
 ("Endosomal/lysosomal loss rate",0.05,"1/h","Endosome -> degraded / retained (not delivered)","0.00"),
 ("Nuclear export rate",0.02,"1/h","Nucleus -> cytosol","0.00"),
 ("Free D3 VDR occupancy at readout",0.20,"fraction","Assumed; rapid CYP24A1 catabolism limits free calcitriol","0.00"),
 ("Readout time",24,"h","Must be a multiple of the time step and <= 48","0"),
 ("Baseline gamma-H2AX foci per nucleus",4,"foci","Assumed baseline DNA double-strand-break marker","0.0"),
 ("gamma-H2AX foci per nM nuclear AuNP",400,"foci/nM","Assumed nuclear gold DNA-damage coefficient","0"),
 ("Flux sensitivity to ATG/BECN1/ULK1 loss (k_flux)",0.8,"-","Toy viability model","0.00"),
 ("Viability sensitivity to DNA damage (k_dna)",0.15,"-","Toy viability model","0.00"),
 ("Flux weight: ATG7",0.5,"-","Weights sum to 1","0.00"),
 ("Flux weight: BECN1",0.3,"-","","0.00"),

]
for i,(a,b,c,d,fm) in enumerate(rows):
    r=4+i; put(wp,f"A{r}",a); put(wp,f"B{r}",b,f_in,fm); put(wp,f"C{r}",c); put(wp,f"D{r}",d,f_note)

put(wp,"A37","Gene panel (RNA model)",f_bold,border=False)
hdr(wp,38,["Gene","Max log2FC at full VDR occupancy","Role","Baseline mean count (simulated library)"])
for i,g in enumerate(GENES):
    r=39+i; put(wp,f"A{r}",g,f_bold); put(wp,f"B{r}",EMAX[i],f_in,"0.0"); put(wp,f"C{r}",ROLE[i],f_note); put(wp,f"D{r}",BASE[i],f_in,"#,##0")

NROW=96; r0=6; r1=r0+NROW
for b,(nm,prow) in enumerate(blocks):

    for j,t in enumerate(["Extracellular","Endosome","Cytosol","Nucleus"]): put(wt,f"{L(c0+j)}5",t,f_hdr,fill=fill_h)
put(wt,f"A{r0}",0,f_in,"0.0")
for b in range(3):

for r in range(r0+1,r1+1):
    put(wt,f"A{r}",f"=A{r-1}+Parameters!$B$4",fmt="0.0")
    for b,(nm,prow) in enumerate(blocks):
        c0=2+4*b; E,En,C,N=[L(c0+j) for j in range(4)]

        dt="Parameters!$B$4"
        put(wt,f"{E}{r}",f"={E}{r-1}-{dt}*Parameters!$B$14*{uf}*{E}{r-1}",fmt="0.0000")
        put(wt,f"{En}{r}",f"={En}{r-1}+{dt}*(Parameters!$B$14*{uf}*{E}{r-1}-(Parameters!$B$15+Parameters!$B$16)*{En}{r-1})",fmt="0.0000")
        put(wt,f"{C}{r}",f"={C}{r-1}+{dt}*(Parameters!$B$15*{En}{r-1}-{kn}*{C}{r-1}+Parameters!$B$17*{N}{r-1})",fmt="0.0000")
        put(wt,f"{N}{r}",f"={N}{r-1}+{dt}*({kn}*{C}{r-1}-Parameters!$B$17*{N}{r-1})",fmt="0.0000")
widths(wt,{"A":10}); 
for c in range(2,14): wt.column_dimensions[L(c)].width=13

ch.height=8; ch.width=16
for b,(nm,_) in enumerate(blocks):

ch.set_categories(Reference(wt,min_col=1,min_row=r0,max_row=r1)); ch.x_axis.tickLblSkip=8
ch.x_axis.delete=False; ch.y_axis.delete=False

tmatch="MATCH(Parameters!$B$19,Transport_Model!$A$6:$A$%d,0)"%r1
for i,n in enumerate(ARMN):

        put(wd,f"D{r}","=Parameters!B18",f_link,"0.000"); put(wd,f"E{r}",0,f_norm,"0.000")
    else:

hdr(wa,4,["Gene","Role","log2FC Free D3","log2FC AuNP 5 nm","log2FC AuNP 15 nm (no NLS)","log2FC AuNP-D3-NLS 15 nm","Model-predicted log2FC (NLS arm)","p-value (NLS vs ctrl)","BH raw","padj (BH)","Call"])

    put(wa,f"K{r}",f'=IF(AND(J{r}<0.05,ABS(F{r})>=1),IF(F{r}>0,"Up","Down"),"NS")',f_bold,al=Alignment(horizontal="center"))

 ("Specificity","=IFERROR(N9/(N9+M9),0)"),("NPV","=IFERROR(N9/(N9+N8),0)"),("F1 score","=IFERROR(2*M13*M14/(M13+M14),0)"),
 ("Prevalence of Responders (random-screen hit rate)","=(M8+N8)/SUM(M8:N9)")]

# ============ Business_Model ============
wbz = wb.create_sheet("Business_Model")
title(wbz,"Business model: low-cost, AI-guided nanoparticle drug-delivery platform",
      "Blue = assumption (illustrative planning values, not sourced quotes: replace with your own). Green = link to the model above. Black = formula.")
A={}
r=[3]
def sec(t):
    r[0]+=1; put(wbz,f"A{r[0]}",t,f_hdr,fill=fill_h); 
    for c in "BCD": put(wbz,f"{c}{r[0]}","",f_hdr,fill=fill_h)
    r[0]+=1
def inp(key,label,val,unit,fmt,note="",kind="in"):
    row=r[0]; put(wbz,f"A{row}",label); 
    put(wbz,f"B{row}",val,{"in":f_in,"f":f_norm,"l":f_link}[kind],fmt); put(wbz,f"C{row}",unit); put(wbz,f"D{row}",note,f_note)
    A[key]=f"$B${row}"; r[0]+=1
sec("1. Cost per formulation tested (lab)")
for k,l,v,n in [("c1","AuNP synthesis & purification materials",180,"HAuCl4, stabilizers, PEG-thiol"),("c2","Vitamin D3 ligand & conjugation reagents",120,""),
  ("c3","NLS peptide",150,"Custom peptide synthesis share"),("c4","Characterization (DLS / TEM / ICP-MS)",220,""),
  ("c5","Cell assays (viability, gamma-H2AX, LC3 imaging)",260,"MCF-7 / MDA-MB-231 / SK-BR-3"),("c6","RNA analysis (qPCR panel / RNA-seq share)",300,""),("c7","Labor & overhead",250,"")]:
    inp(k,l,v,"$ / formulation","$#,##0",n)
inp("cform","Cost per formulation tested",f"=SUM({A['c1']}:{A['c7']})","$ / formulation","$#,##0","Sum of the lines above",kind="f")
sec("2. Screening campaign: traditional vs AI-guided (per delivery program)")
inp("hits","Validated hits required per program",10,"hits","0","Assumption")
inp("mult","Assay multiplicity (cell lines x independent runs)",6,"x","0","e.g. 3 cell lines x 2 runs")
inp("hr","Hit rate under empirical screening",f"=Confusion_Matrix!M18","fraction","0.0%","Equals Responder prevalence in the simulated design space",kind="l")
inp("prec","AI precision (share of AI-selected formulations that are hits)","=Confusion_Matrix!M13","fraction","0.0%","From confusion matrix",kind="l")
inp("rec","AI recall (share of true hits the AI finds)","=Confusion_Matrix!M14","fraction","0.0%","From confusion matrix (hits missed are not tested)",kind="l")
inp("ovh","AI validation overhead factor",1.3,"x","0.00","Extra negative-control / audit testing")
inp("tput","Lab throughput",25,"formulation-runs / month","0","Assumption")
inp("delay","Client cost of delay",60000,"$ / month","$#,##0","Assumption: opportunity cost of a slower program")
inp("fee","Platform fee charged per program",400000,"$ / program","$#,##0","Key pricing lever")
inp("trf","Traditional: formulations tested",f"={A['hits']}/{A['hr']}","formulations","0.0","Hits / hit rate",kind="f")
inp("trr","Traditional: formulation-runs",f"={A['trf']}*{A['mult']}","runs","0","",kind="f")
inp("trc","Traditional: screening cost per program",f"={A['trr']}*{A['cform']}","$","$#,##0","",kind="f")
inp("aif","AI-guided: formulations tested",f"={A['hits']}/{A['prec']}*{A['ovh']}","formulations","0.0","Hits / precision x overhead",kind="f")
inp("air","AI-guided: formulation-runs",f"={A['aif']}*{A['mult']}","runs","0","",kind="f")
inp("aic","AI-guided: screening cost per program",f"={A['air']}*{A['cform']}","$","$#,##0","Platform's cost to serve",kind="f")
inp("sav","Screening cost saved per program",f"={A['trc']}-{A['aic']}","$","$#,##0","",kind="f")
inp("pct","Screening cost reduction",f"=IFERROR({A['sav']}/{A['trc']},0)","%","0.0%","",kind="f")
inp("mt","Months: traditional",f"={A['trr']}/{A['tput']}","months","0.0","",kind="f")
inp("ma","Months: AI-guided",f"={A['air']}/{A['tput']}","months","0.0","",kind="f")
inp("ms","Months saved",f"={A['mt']}-{A['ma']}","months","0.0","",kind="f")
inp("tv","Value of time saved",f"={A['ms']}*{A['delay']}","$","$#,##0","",kind="f")
inp("cb","Client gross benefit (cost + time saved)",f"={A['sav']}+{A['tv']}","$","$#,##0","",kind="f")
inp("cn","Client net benefit after fee",f"={A['cb']}-{A['fee']}","$","$#,##0","",kind="f")
inp("croi","Client return on fee",f"=IFERROR({A['cn']}/{A['fee']},0)","x","0.0x","",kind="f")
sec("3. Product cost of goods per dose (therapeutic use)")
for k,l,v,u,fm,n in [("gold","Gold per dose",0.05,"mg","0.000","Assumption"),("gp","Gold price",120,"$ / g","$#,##0","Illustrative: update to current market price"),
  ("d3","D3 ligand per dose",0.40,"$","$0.00","Assumption"),("nls","NLS peptide per dose",1.80,"$","$0.00","Assumption"),
  ("exc","PEG / linker / excipients per dose",0.60,"$","$0.00","Assumption"),("qc","Sterile fill & QC per dose",4.00,"$","$0.00","Assumption")]:
    inp(k,l,v,u,fm,n)
inp("goldc","Gold cost per dose",f"={A['gold']}/1000*{A['gp']}","$","$0.00","",kind="f")
inp("cogs","COGS per dose",f"={A['goldc']}+{A['d3']}+{A['nls']}+{A['exc']}+{A['qc']}","$","$0.00","",kind="f")
inp("ref","Reference nanocarrier COGS per dose (liposome / polymer)",35,"$","$0.00","Assumption for comparison")
inp("cred","COGS advantage vs reference",f"=IFERROR(1-{A['cogs']}/{A['ref']},0)","%","0.0%","",kind="f")
sec("4. Platform company financials (5 years)")
inp("build","AI model build (one-time, Year 0)",150000,"$","$#,##0","Data science, compute")
inp("trn","Initial training-set formulations",150,"formulations","0","Wet-lab data to train the model")
inp("mlops","Annual MLOps / cloud",60000,"$ / yr","$#,##0","")
inp("disc","Discount rate",0.12,"%","0.0%","")
row=r[0]+1
hdr(wbz,row,["Line item","Year 0","Year 1","Year 2","Year 3","Year 4","Year 5"]); hy=row
progs=[0,2,4,7,10,14]; opex=[0,700000,800000,950000,1100000,1300000]
lines=["Programs delivered","Revenue ($)","Cost to serve ($)","Gross profit ($)","Gross margin","Fixed opex ($)","MLOps ($)","Upfront investment ($)","Net cash flow ($)","Cumulative cash ($)","Discount factor","Present value ($)"]
L0=row+1; rowof={n:L0+i for i,n in enumerate(lines)}
for n in lines: put(wbz,f"A{rowof[n]}",n,f_bold if n in("Net cash flow ($)","Cumulative cash ($)") else f_norm)
for k in range(6):
    c=L(2+k); R=rowof
    put(wbz,f"{c}{R['Programs delivered']}",progs[k],f_in,"0")
    put(wbz,f"{c}{R['Revenue ($)']}",f"={c}{R['Programs delivered']}*{A['fee']}",fmt="$#,##0;($#,##0);-")
    put(wbz,f"{c}{R['Cost to serve ($)']}",f"={c}{R['Programs delivered']}*{A['aic']}",fmt="$#,##0;($#,##0);-")
    put(wbz,f"{c}{R['Gross profit ($)']}",f"={c}{R['Revenue ($)']}-{c}{R['Cost to serve ($)']}",fmt="$#,##0;($#,##0);-")
    put(wbz,f"{c}{R['Gross margin']}",f"=IFERROR({c}{R['Gross profit ($)']}/{c}{R['Revenue ($)']},0)",fmt="0.0%;(0.0%);-")
    put(wbz,f"{c}{R['Fixed opex ($)']}",opex[k],f_in,"$#,##0;($#,##0);-")
    put(wbz,f"{c}{R['MLOps ($)']}",0 if k==0 else f"={A['mlops']}",f_norm,"$#,##0;($#,##0);-")
    put(wbz,f"{c}{R['Upfront investment ($)']}",f"={A['build']}+{A['trn']}*{A['cform']}" if k==0 else 0,fmt="$#,##0;($#,##0);-")
    put(wbz,f"{c}{R['Net cash flow ($)']}",f"={c}{R['Gross profit ($)']}-{c}{R['Fixed opex ($)']}-{c}{R['MLOps ($)']}-{c}{R['Upfront investment ($)']}",f_bold,"$#,##0;($#,##0);-")
    prev = f"{L(1+k)}{R['Cumulative cash ($)']}+" if k>0 else ""
    put(wbz,f"{c}{R['Cumulative cash ($)']}",f"={prev}{c}{R['Net cash flow ($)']}",f_bold,"$#,##0;($#,##0);-")
    put(wbz,f"{c}{R['Discount factor']}",f"=1/(1+{A['disc']})^{k}",fmt="0.000")
    put(wbz,f"{c}{R['Present value ($)']}",f"={c}{R['Net cash flow ($)']}*{c}{R['Discount factor']}",fmt="$#,##0;($#,##0);-")
r[0]=L0+len(lines)+1

for c in "BCD": put(wbz,f"{c}{r[0]}","",f_hdr,fill=fill_h)
r[0]+=1

inp("npv","NPV of 5-year cash flows",f"=SUM(B{R['Present value ($)']}:G{R['Present value ($)']})","$","$#,##0;($#,##0)","",kind="f")

inp("cum","5-year cumulative cash",f"=G{R['Cumulative cash ($)']}","$","$#,##0;($#,##0)","",kind="f")
inp("be","Break-even programs per year (Year 1 cost base)",f"=IFERROR((C{R['Fixed opex ($)']}+{A['mlops']})/({A['fee']}-{A['aic']}),0)","programs","0.0","Fixed costs / margin per program",kind="f")
inp("y5m","Year 5 gross margin",f"=G{R['Gross margin']}","%","0.0%","",kind="f")

paper_extension_workbook.py

Builds VD3GNP_Paper_Extension_Model.xlsx (univariate, bivariate, NUP, clinical)

import numpy as np
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter as L
from openpyxl.chart import LineChart, BarChart, ScatterChart, Reference, Series
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import ColorScaleRule
import science as S
import os
OUT=os.environ.get('OUT_DIR','outputs'); os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)

wb=Workbook(); F="Arial"
fn=Font(name=F,size=10); fb=Font(name=F,size=10,bold=True); fi=Font(name=F,size=10,color="0000FF"); fl=Font(name=F,size=10,color="008000")
fh=Font(name=F,size=10,bold=True,color="FFFFFF"); ft=Font(name=F,size=14,bold=True,color="1F3A5F"); fnote=Font(name=F,size=9,italic=True,color="595959")
fred=Font(name=F,size=10,bold=True,color="C00000")
hf=PatternFill("solid",fgColor="1F3A5F"); yf=PatternFill("solid",fgColor="FFFF00"); sf=PatternFill("solid",fgColor="E8EEF5")
th=Side(style="thin",color="BFBFBF"); bx=Border(left=th,right=th,top=th,bottom=th)
wr=Alignment(wrap_text=True,vertical="top")
def put(ws,ref,v,font=fn,fmt=None,fill=None,al=None,border=True):
    c=ws[ref]; c.value=v; c.font=font
    if fmt:c.number_format=fmt
    if fill:c.fill=fill
    if al:c.alignment=al
    if border:c.border=bx
    return c
def hdr(ws,row,vals,col=1):
    for i,v in enumerate(vals): put(ws,f"{L(col+i)}{row}",v,fh,fill=hf,al=Alignment(wrap_text=True,horizontal="center",vertical="center"))
def title(ws,t,sub=None):
    ws["A1"].value=t; ws["A1"].font=ft
    if sub: ws["A2"].value=sub; ws["A2"].font=fnote
def sect(ws,r,t): ws[f"A{r}"].value=t; ws[f"A{r}"].font=fb
def widths(ws,d):
    for k,v in d.items(): ws.column_dimensions[k].width=v
PCT="0.0%"

# ---------- Paper_Data ----------
wp=wb.active; wp.title="Paper_Data"
title(wp,"Published data: Roy M, Hussain F. Int J Mol Sci 2024;25(10):5348 (doi 10.3390/ijms25105348)",
 "Values transcribed from the open-access article (Results 2.1-2.2). Blue = published value. Treatment: 24 h, 10 ug/mL VD3-GNP (38 nM VD3 by HPLC), n = 3 independent replicates.")
sect(wp,4,"A. Nanoparticle characterisation")
hdr(wp,5,["Parameter","Value","SD / +-","n","Unit","Source / note"])
A=[("TEM core diameter, VD3-GNP",16.6,2.41,111,"nm","Section 2.1.1; used as the particle size for all modelling here"),
 ("TEM diameter, bare GNP",26.11,9.02,202,"nm","Section 2.1.1"),

 ("UV-Vis peak, VD3-GNP",530,"","","nm","Bare GNP 526 nm"),
 ("Zeta potential, VD3-GNP",24.4,1.8,"","mV","Sign inconsistent in paper: +24.4 in Results 2.1.5, -24.4 in Discussion. Please confirm."),

for i,(a,b,c,d,e,f) in enumerate(A):
    r=6+i; put(wp,f"A{r}",a); put(wp,f"B{r}",b,fi,"0.00"); put(wp,f"C{r}",c,fi,"0.00"); put(wp,f"D{r}",d,fi,"0"); put(wp,f"E{r}",e); put(wp,f"F{r}",f,fnote)
# rows: 6 TEM,7 GNP TEM,8 DLS,9 GNP DLS,10 UV,11 zeta,12 zeta GNP,13 HPLC,14 VD3 assay

    r=19+i; put(wp,f"A{r}",a); put(wp,f"B{r}",b,fi,"0.00"); put(wp,f"C{r}",c,fi,"0.00"); put(wp,f"D{r}",d); put(wp,f"E{r}",""); put(wp,f"F{r}",e,fnote)

for i,e in enumerate(S.ENDP):

# rows 26..33

notes=["1. MCF-7 mTOR (214.4%) and ETV7 (109.4%) are reported as decreases above 100%, which is not possible for a % decrease. They may be fold-changes or ratio-based values; the model caps them (Parameters).",
"2. ETV7 in MDA-MB-231 fell 37% but was not significant (ns); only MCF-7 ETV7 shows significance. The abstract's ETV7 claim therefore rests mainly on MCF-7.",
"3. AKT, mTOR and several other endpoints are ns in one or both lines; effect sizes here are point estimates.",
"4. Zeta potential sign differs between Results and Discussion. 5. PDI > 1 and aggregation were reported; this matters for nuclear-pore size limits and for GMP reproducibility.",
"6. Only two cell lines, one time point (24 h), one dose and no animal data (authors' own Limitations)."]
for i,n in enumerate(notes):
    put(wp,f"A{36+i}",n,fnote,border=False,al=wr); wp.merge_cells(f"A{36+i}:F{36+i}"); wp.row_dimensions[36+i].height=28
widths(wp,{"A":40,"B":18,"C":22,"D":18,"E":18,"F":80}); wp.row_dimensions[25].height=30

# ---------- Parameters ----------
wq=wb.create_sheet("Parameters")
title(wq,"Model parameters (blue = editable assumption, green = linked to published data)","Yellow = key levers. Assumptions are placeholders to be replaced with your measurements.")

PR={}
def prm(key,label,val,unit,note,fmt="0.00",kind="in",key_lever=False):
    r=4+len(PR); PR[key]=f"Parameters!$B${r}"
    put(wq,f"A{r}",label); c=put(wq,f"B{r}",val,{"in":fi,"l":fl,"f":fn}[kind],fmt)
    if key_lever: c.fill=yf
    put(wq,f"C{r}",unit); put(wq,f"D{r}",note,fnote)

prm("dsd","TEM diameter SD","=Paper_Data!C6","nm","Published","0.00","l")

for nm,key in [("PI3K","wPI3K"),("p-AKT","wpAKT"),("mTOR","wmTOR"),("ETV7","wETV7"),("YAP","wYAP"),("TAZ","wTAZ")]:

    put(wm,f"H{r}",f"={P(wmap[i])}" if wmap[i] else 0,fl if wmap[i] else fn,"0.0000")

put(wm,"A21","Prediction error (pred - obs)"); put(wm,"B21","=B20-B17",fmt="0.0%;-0.0%"); put(wm,"C21","=C20-C17",fmt="0.0%;-0.0%")
put(wm,"A22","Composite pathway reduction (1 - composite)"); put(wm,"B22","=1-B16",fmt=PCT); put(wm,"C22","=1-C16",fmt=PCT)

 "Particle size is the paper's: TEM core 16.6 nm, hydrodynamic 34.6 nm (PEG-VD3 shell). Whether intact particles reach the nucleus was not measured in the paper; this sheet quantifies when it is physically possible.")

hdr(wn,5,["Quantity","Value","Unit","Note"])
G=[("TEM core mean",f"={P('dcore')}","nm","l","0.0"),("TEM core SD",f"={P('dsd')}","nm","l","0.00"),("Hydrodynamic diameter",f"={P('dh')}","nm","l","0.0"),
 ("Effective shell thickness in pore",f"={P('corona')}*{P('comp')}","nm","f","0.0"),("Effective diameter in pore (core + 2 x shell)",f"=B6+2*B9","nm","f","0.0"),
 ("Passive limit",f"={P('dpass')}","nm","l","0.0"),("NPC channel limit",f"={P('dnpc')}","nm","l","0.0"),
 ("Largest core that fits channel",f"=B12-2*B9","nm","f","0.0"),
 ("Fraction of population whose core fits channel","=NORMDIST(B13,B6,B7,TRUE)","fraction","f","0.0%"),
 ("Fraction capable of passive diffusion","=NORMDIST(B11-2*B9,B6,B7,TRUE)","fraction","f","0.00%"),
 ("Margin: channel limit minus effective diameter","=B12-B10","nm","f","0.0")]
for i,(n,f,u,k,fm) in enumerate(G):
    r=6+i; put(wn,f"A{r}",n); put(wn,f"B{r}",f,fl if k=="l" else fn,fm); put(wn,f"C{r}",u)
put(wn,"D13","Channel fits if core + 2 x shell <= limit",fnote); put(wn,"D14","Aggregates (PDI 1.6) fall outside this population",fnote); put(wn,"D15","Passive entry needs a particle near 5 nm: not available here",fnote)
sect(wn,19,"B. NPC capacity")
put(wn,"A20","Max particle throughput per nucleus"); put(wn,"B20",f"={P('npc')}*{P('trans')}*{P('share')}*B14",fmt="#,##0.0"); put(wn,"C20","particles/s"); put(wn,"D20","NPCs x events/s x share x fraction that fits",fnote)
put(wn,"A21","Time to deliver target particles"); put(wn,"B21",f"=IFERROR({P('npart')}/B20,0)",fmt="0.000"); put(wn,"C21","s"); put(wn,"D21","Capacity is not limiting; recognition (NLS/importin) is",fnote)
put(wn,"A22","Active import rate (no NLS: 0)"); put(wn,"B22",f"=0*{P('kact')}*MAX(0,1-{P('dh')}/{P('dnpc')})",fmt="0.0000"); put(wn,"C22","1/h")
put(wn,"A23","Active import rate with NLS added"); put(wn,"B23",f"=1*{P('kact')}*MAX(0,1-{P('dh')}/{P('dnpc')})",fmt="0.0000"); put(wn,"C23","1/h"); put(wn,"D23","Falls as size approaches the 39 nm limit",fnote)
put(wn,"A24","Passive import rate"); put(wn,"B24",f"={P('kp0')}/(1+EXP(({P('dh')}-{P('d50')})/{P('wd')}))",fmt="0.000000"); put(wn,"C24","1/h")

nup_autophagy.py

NUP x autophagy correlation analysis (accepts --input real data)

"""Correlation matrix of nucleoporins (NUPs), autophagy markers and the paper's pathway genes.
Default: SIMULATED expression with an assumed latent structure. Use --input genes.csv (rows = samples,
columns = genes, log-expression) to run the same analysis on real data such as TCGA-BRCA."""
import argparse, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, leaves_list

NUP = ["RANBP2", "NUP214", "NUP153", "TPR", "NUP98", "NUP62", "NUP93", "NUP205", "NUP155", "POM121", "NDC1", "NUP210"]
AUTO = ["ULK1", "BECN1", "ATG5", "ATG7", "ATG12", "ATG16L1", "MAP1LC3B", "GABARAP", "SQSTM1", "TFEB"]
PATH = ["ETV7", "YAP1", "WWTR1", "MTOR"]
GENES = NUP + AUTO + PATH
BLOCK = {g: "NUP" for g in NUP} | {g: "Autophagy" for g in AUTO} | {g: "Paper pathway" for g in PATH}
# loadings on latent factors: npc, basket, auto, lyso, mtor, hippo
LOAD = {}
for g in ["NUP93", "NUP205", "NUP155", "NUP62"]: LOAD[g] = {"npc": .75}
for g in ["POM121", "NDC1", "NUP210"]: LOAD[g] = {"npc": .55}
for g in ["RANBP2", "NUP214"]: LOAD[g] = {"npc": .50}
for g in ["NUP153", "TPR", "NUP98"]: LOAD[g] = {"npc": .50, "basket": .50}
for g in ["ULK1", "ATG5", "ATG12", "ATG16L1"]: LOAD[g] = {"auto": .60}
for g in ["BECN1", "ATG7"]: LOAD[g] = {"auto": .60, "basket": .35}      # assumed NUP-basket link (hypothesis)
for g in ["MAP1LC3B", "GABARAP", "SQSTM1", "TFEB"]: LOAD[g] = {"lyso": .65, "auto": .25}
LOAD["MTOR"] = {"mtor": .70, "npc": .20}; LOAD["YAP1"] = {"hippo": .70, "mtor": .30}
LOAD["WWTR1"] = {"hippo": .70, "mtor": .30}; LOAD["ETV7"] = {"hippo": .30, "mtor": .30}
FACT = ["npc", "basket", "auto", "lyso", "mtor", "hippo"]

def simulate(n=200, seed=3):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed); Z = {f: rng.normal(size=n) for f in FACT}; X = {}
    for g in GENES:
        l = LOAD[g]; ss = sum(v * v for v in l.values()); sig = np.sqrt(max(0.15, 1 - ss))
        X[g] = 5 + 1.2 * (sum(v * Z[f] for f, v in l.items()) + sig * rng.normal(size=n))
    return pd.DataFrame(X, index=[f"S{i+1:03d}" for i in range(n)])[GENES]

def analyse(df):
    pear = df.corr("pearson"); spear = df.corr("spearman"); n = len(df)
    t = pear * np.sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - pear**2 + 1e-12)); pv = pd.DataFrame(2 * stats.t.sf(np.abs(t), n - 2), index=pear.index, columns=pear.columns)
    iu = np.triu_indices(len(pear), 1); p = pv.values[iu]; order = np.argsort(p); q = np.empty_like(p); m = len(p)
    q[order] = np.minimum.accumulate((p[order] * m / (np.arange(m) + 1))[::-1])[::-1]; q = np.minimum(q, 1)
    rows = [(pear.index[i], pear.columns[j], pear.values[i, j], spear.values[i, j], pv.values[i, j], qq)
            for i, j, qq in zip(*iu, q)]
    pairs = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["gene_1", "gene_2", "pearson_r", "spearman_rho", "p_value", "fdr_bh"])
    pairs["block_pair"] = pairs.gene_1.map(BLOCK) + " x " + pairs.gene_2.map(BLOCK)
    return pear, spear, pv, pairs

def cluster_order(corr):
    from scipy.spatial.distance import squareform
    z = linkage(squareform(1 - corr.values, checks=False), "average")
    return [corr.index[i] for i in leaves_list(z)]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument("--input"); ap.add_argument("--out", default="nup_autophagy_corr.csv"); a = ap.parse_args()
    df = pd.read_csv(a.input, index_col=0) if a.input else simulate()
    pear, spear, pv, pairs = analyse(df); pear.to_csv(a.out); print(pairs.sort_values("p_value").head(15))

Correlation workbook and heatmaps

"""NUP x autophagy correlation workbook (live CORREL formulas) and heatmap PNGs."""
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter as L
from openpyxl.drawing.image import Image
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import ColorScaleRule
import nup_autophagy as N

F = "Arial"; fn = Font(name=F, size=10); fb = Font(name=F, size=10, bold=True); fi = Font(name=F, size=10, color="0000FF"); fh = Font(name=F, size=10, bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
ft = Font(name=F, size=14, bold=True, color="1F3A5F"); fnote = Font(name=F, size=9, italic=True, color="595959"); fred = Font(name=F, size=10, bold=True, color="C00000")
hf = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F3A5F"); th = Side(style="thin", color="BFBFBF"); bx = Border(left=th, right=th, top=th, bottom=th)
def put(ws, ref, v, font=fn, fmt=None, fill=None, al=None):
    c = ws[ref]; c.value = v; c.font = font; c.border = bx
    if fmt: c.number_format = fmt
    if fill: c.fill = fill
    if al: c.alignment = al
    return c
RB = ColorScaleRule(start_type="num", start_value=-1, start_color="F8696B", mid_type="num", mid_value=0, mid_color="FFFFFF", end_type="num", end_value=1, end_color="5A8AC6")

def heatmaps(out, pear, pairs):
    order = N.cluster_order(pear); c = pear.loc[order, order]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 8)); im = ax.imshow(c.values, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-1, vmax=1)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(c))); ax.set_xticklabels(c.columns, rotation=90, fontsize=7); ax.set_yticks(range(len(c))); ax.set_yticklabels(c.index, fontsize=7)
    col = {"NUP": "#1F77B4", "Autophagy": "#2CA02C", "Paper pathway": "#FF7F0E"}
    for lab in ax.get_xticklabels() + ax.get_yticklabels(): lab.set_color(col[N.BLOCK[lab.get_text()]])
    plt.colorbar(im, label="Pearson r"); ax.set_title("Clustered correlation: NUPs (blue), autophagy (green), paper pathway (orange)", fontsize=9)
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{out}/07a_nup_autophagy_clustered.png", dpi=160); plt.close()
    x = pear.loc[N.NUP, N.AUTO]; fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6)); ax.imshow(x.values, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-.5, vmax=.5)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(N.AUTO))); ax.set_xticklabels(N.AUTO, rotation=45, ha="right", fontsize=8); ax.set_yticks(range(len(N.NUP))); ax.set_yticklabels(N.NUP, fontsize=8)
    for i in range(len(N.NUP)):
        for j in range(len(N.AUTO)): ax.text(j, i, f"{x.values[i,j]:.2f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=6.5)
    ax.set_title("NUP x autophagy-marker Pearson r (colour range -0.5 to 0.5)", fontsize=10); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{out}/07b_nup_x_autophagy.png", dpi=160); plt.close()

def build(xlsx, chart_dir, df=None):
    import os; os.makedirs(chart_dir, exist_ok=True)
    simulated = df is None; df = N.simulate() if df is None else df
    pear, spear, pv, pairs = N.analyse(df); heatmaps(chart_dir, pear, pairs); n = len(df); genes = list(df.columns)
    wb = Workbook(); ws = wb.active; ws.title = "Summary"; ws["A1"].value = "Correlation matrix: nucleoporins (NUPs), autophagy markers and the paper's pathway genes"; ws["A1"].font = ft
    ws["A2"].value = ("SIMULATED expression with an assumed latent structure (NUP basket factor linked weakly to BECN1/ATG7). It illustrates the method and tests the pipeline; it is not evidence. "
                      "Replace the Expression sheet with real log-expression (e.g. TCGA-BRCA via UALCAN/GDC) and every matrix recalculates.") if simulated else "Real expression data supplied."
    ws["A2"].font = fred; ws["A2"].alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True, vertical="top"); ws.merge_cells("A2:H4")
    cross = pairs[pairs.block_pair.isin(["NUP x Autophagy"])].sort_values("p_value")
    rows = [("Samples", n), ("Genes", len(genes)), ("NUP x autophagy pairs tested", len(N.NUP) * len(N.AUTO)), ("Pairs with FDR < 0.05 (all 325 pairs)", int((pairs.fdr_bh < .05).sum())),
            ("NUP x autophagy pairs with FDR < 0.05", int((cross.fdr_bh < .05).sum())), ("Strongest NUP x autophagy pair", f"{cross.iloc[0].gene_1} / {cross.iloc[0].gene_2} (r = {cross.iloc[0].pearson_r:.2f})")]
    for i, (a, b) in enumerate(rows): put(ws, f"A{6+i}", a, fb); put(ws, f"B{6+i}", b)
    ws["A13"].value = "Sheets: Expression (input), Pearson (live CORREL), Spearman and p-values (Python), NUP_x_Autophagy (live link), Top_Pairs (BH-FDR), Heatmaps."; ws["A13"].font = fnote
    ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 46; ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 40
    we = wb.create_sheet("Expression"); we["A1"].value = "Expression matrix (log2 scale; rows = samples). Blue = input."; we["A1"].font = fb
    put(we, "A4", "Sample", fh, fill=hf)
    for j, g in enumerate(genes): put(we, f"{L(2+j)}3", N.BLOCK[g], fnote); put(we, f"{L(2+j)}4", g, fh, fill=hf)
    for i, (idx, rw) in enumerate(df.iterrows()):
        put(we, f"A{5+i}", idx)
        for j, g in enumerate(genes): put(we, f"{L(2+j)}{5+i}", round(float(rw[g]), 3), fi, "0.00")
    last = 4 + n; we.freeze_panes = "B5"; we.column_dimensions["A"].width = 10
    wp = wb.create_sheet("Pearson"); wp["A1"].value = "Pearson r (live formulas on Expression)"; wp["A1"].font = fb
    for j, g in enumerate(genes): put(wp, f"{L(2+j)}3", g, fh, fill=hf, al=Alignment(text_rotation=90)); put(wp, f"A{4+j}", g, fb)
    for i in range(len(genes)):
        for j in range(len(genes)):
            put(wp, f"{L(2+j)}{4+i}", f"=CORREL(Expression!${L(2+i)}$5:${L(2+i)}${last},Expression!${L(2+j)}$5:${L(2+j)}${last})", fn, "0.00")
    e = 3 + len(genes); wp.conditional_formatting.add(f"B4:{L(1+len(genes))}{e+1}", RB); wp.column_dimensions["A"].width = 10; wp.row_dimensions[3].height = 60
    for j in range(len(genes)): wp.column_dimensions[L(2 + j)].width = 6.5
    wx = wb.create_sheet("NUP_x_Autophagy"); wx["A1"].value = "NUP x autophagy-marker Pearson r (links to Pearson sheet)"; wx["A1"].font = fb
    for j, g in enumerate(N.AUTO): put(wx, f"{L(2+j)}3", g, fh, fill=hf)
    for i, gn in enumerate(N.NUP):
        put(wx, f"A{4+i}", gn, fb)
        for j, ga in enumerate(N.AUTO): put(wx, f"{L(2+j)}{4+i}", f"=Pearson!{L(2+genes.index(ga))}{4+genes.index(gn)}", fn, "0.00")
    wx.conditional_formatting.add("B4:K15", RB); wx.column_dimensions["A"].width = 12
    for j in range(10): wx.column_dimensions[L(2 + j)].width = 11
    ws2 = wb.create_sheet("Spearman"); ws2["A1"].value = "Spearman rho (computed in Python)"; ws2["A1"].font = fb
    for j, g in enumerate(genes): put(ws2, f"{L(2+j)}3", g, fh, fill=hf, al=Alignment(text_rotation=90)); put(ws2, f"A{4+j}", g, fb)
    for i, gi in enumerate(genes):
        for j, gj in enumerate(genes): put(ws2, f"{L(2+j)}{4+i}", float(spear.loc[gi, gj]), fi, "0.00")
    ws2.conditional_formatting.add(f"B4:{L(1+len(genes))}{3+len(genes)}", RB)
    for j in range(len(genes)): ws2.column_dimensions[L(2 + j)].width = 6.5
    ws2.row_dimensions[3].height = 60
    wt = wb.create_sheet("Top_Pairs"); wt["A1"].value = "All gene pairs ranked by p-value (Python; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR)"; wt["A1"].font = fb
    for j, h in enumerate(["Gene 1", "Gene 2", "Block pair", "Pearson r", "Spearman rho", "p-value", "FDR (BH)"]): put(wt, f"{L(1+j)}3", h, fh, fill=hf)
    for i, (_, r_) in enumerate(pairs.sort_values("p_value").iterrows()):
        for j, (v, f_) in enumerate([(r_.gene_1, None), (r_.gene_2, None), (r_.block_pair, None), (r_.pearson_r, "0.000"), (r_.spearman_rho, "0.000"), (r_.p_value, "0.0000"), (r_.fdr_bh, "0.0000")]):
            put(wt, f"{L(1+j)}{4+i}", v if isinstance(v, str) else float(v), fn, f_)
    for c, w in zip("ABCDEFG", [12, 12, 26, 11, 13, 11, 11]): wt.column_dimensions[c].width = w
    wh = wb.create_sheet("Heatmaps")
    for i, p in enumerate(["07a_nup_autophagy_clustered", "07b_nup_x_autophagy"]):
        img = Image(f"{chart_dir}/{p}.png"); img.width = 560; img.height = 500 if i == 0 else 420; wh.add_image(img, f"A{1+i*28}" if False else ("A1" if i == 0 else "L1"))
    wb.save(xlsx); return pear, pairs

business.py

Four business models, tornado, scenarios, Monte Carlo

"""Cost and business-analytics study for four VD3-GNP business models (5-year horizon).
Deterministic model (mirrored by live Excel formulas), tornado sensitivity, scenarios and Monte Carlo."""
import copy, numpy as np

YEARS = 6  # Year 0..5
B = dict(
    r=0.12,
    # unit costs
    cform_lines=[180, 120, 150, 220, 260, 300, 250], hits=10, mult=6, hit_rate=0.175, prec=0.78, ovh=1.3,
    kit_lines=[22, 48, 35, 15, 20],
    # M1 platform service
    m1_prog=[0, 2, 4, 7, 10, 14], m1_fee=400000, m1_opex=[0, 700000, 800000, 950000, 1100000, 1300000],
    m1_mlops=60000, m1_build=150000, m1_data_n=150,
    # M2 out-license
    m2_ip=120000, m2_pre=[0, 700000, 500000, 0, 0, 0], m2_bd=250000, m2_up=2.0e6, m2_pdeal=0.35, m2_upyr=3,
    m2_mile=3.0e6, m2_pmile=0.15, m2_mileyr=5,
    # M3 supply / kits
    m3_units=[0, 800, 2500, 6000, 12000, 20000], m3_price=450, m3_lr=0.90, m3_uref=1000,
    m3_opex=[0, 450000, 600000, 800000, 1000000, 1200000], m3_sm=0.15, m3_capex=[400000, 0, 300000, 0, 0, 0],
    # M4 in-house development (rNPV)
    m4_cost=[0.5e6, 2.5e6, 3.5e6, 6.0e6, 8.0e6, 0], m4_p=[0.60, 0.60, 0.35, 0.50], m4_deal=60e6, m4_r=0.15,
)
NAMES = {"M1": "AI-guided formulation platform (service)", "M2": "Out-license of VD3-GNP IP", "M3": "Nanoparticle kit / GMP-ready supply", "M4": "In-house clinical development (rNPV)"}

def derived(b):
    cform = sum(b['cform_lines']); cts = b['hits'] / b['prec'] * b['ovh'] * b['mult'] * cform
    trad = b['hits'] / b['hit_rate'] * b['mult'] * cform
    return dict(cform=cform, cts=cts, trad=trad, c0=sum(b['kit_lines']))

def npv(cf, r): return float(sum(c / (1 + r)**t for t, c in enumerate(cf)))
def irr(cf):
    lo, hi = -0.99, 10.0
    f = lambda x: sum(c / (1 + x)**t for t, c in enumerate(cf))
    if f(lo) * f(hi) > 0: return None
    for _ in range(200):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        lo, hi = (mid, hi) if f(lo) * f(mid) > 0 else (lo, mid)
    return (lo + hi) / 2

def cashflows(b):
    d = derived(b); out = {}
    prog = np.array(b['m1_prog'], float); rev = prog * b['m1_fee']; cogs = prog * d['cts']
    opex = np.array(b['m1_opex'], float); ml = np.array([0] + [b['m1_mlops']] * 5, float)
    up = np.array([b['m1_build'] + b['m1_data_n'] * d['cform']] + [0] * 5, float)
    out['M1'] = rev - cogs - opex - ml - up
    rev2 = np.array([(b['m2_up'] * b['m2_pdeal'] if t == b['m2_upyr'] else 0) + (b['m2_mile'] * b['m2_pmile'] if t == b['m2_mileyr'] else 0) for t in range(YEARS)])
    cost2 = np.array([b['m2_ip'] if t == 0 else 0 for t in range(YEARS)]) + np.array(b['m2_pre'], float) + np.array([0] + [b['m2_bd']] * 5)
    out['M2'] = rev2 - cost2
    u = np.array(b['m3_units'], float); cum = np.cumsum(u)
    uc = d['c0'] * (np.maximum(cum, b['m3_uref']) / b['m3_uref'])**(np.log(b['m3_lr']) / np.log(2))
    rev3 = u * b['m3_price']; out['M3'] = rev3 - u * uc - rev3 * b['m3_sm'] - np.array(b['m3_opex'], float) - np.array(b['m3_capex'], float)
    p = b['m4_p']; mult = [1, 1, p[0], p[0] * p[1], p[0] * p[1] * p[2], 0]
    exitv = np.array([0] * 5 + [b['m4_deal'] * p[0] * p[1] * p[2] * p[3]])
    out['M4'] = exitv - np.array(b['m4_cost'], float) * np.array(mult)
    return out

def metrics(b):
    cf = cashflows(b); res = {}
    for k, v in cf.items():
        r = b['m4_r'] if k == 'M4' else b['r']; cum = np.cumsum(v)
        res[k] = dict(npv=npv(v, r), irr=irr(list(v)), peak=float(cum.min()), cum5=float(cum[-1]),
                      payback=int((cum < 0).sum()) if cum[-1] >= 0 else None, cf=list(map(float, v)), cum=list(map(float, cum)))
    return res

def scale(b, key, f):
    c = copy.deepcopy(b); v = c[key]
    if isinstance(v, list): c[key] = [x * f for x in v]
    else: c[key] = v * f
    if key in ('m2_pdeal', 'm2_pmile'): c[key] = min(1, c[key])
    if key == 'm4_p': c[key] = [min(1, x) for x in c[key]]
    return c

TORNADO = {"M1": [("m1_fee", "Fee per program"), ("m1_prog", "Programs delivered"), ("m1_opex", "Fixed opex"), ("r", "Discount rate"), ("m1_mlops", "MLOps cost"), ("hits", "Hits required (cost to serve)"), ("m1_build", "Model build cost")],
           "M3": [("m3_price", "Price per kit"), ("m3_units", "Units sold"), ("m3_opex", "Fixed opex"), ("m3_sm", "Sales & marketing %"), ("m3_lr", "Learning-curve rate"), ("m3_capex", "Capex"), ("r", "Discount rate")],
           "M4": [("m4_deal", "Deal value"), ("m4_p", "Stage success probabilities"), ("m4_cost", "Development cost"), ("m4_r", "Discount rate")]}

def tornado(model, swing=0.20, b=B):
    base = metrics(b)[model]['npv']; rows = []
    for key, lab in TORNADO[model]:
        lo = metrics(scale(b, key, 1 - swing))[model]['npv']; hi = metrics(scale(b, key, 1 + swing))[model]['npv']
        rows.append((lab, lo, hi, abs(hi - lo)))
    return base, sorted(rows, key=lambda x: -x[3])

SCEN = {"Pessimistic": dict(vol=0.6, price=0.85, cost=1.25, p=0.7), "Base": dict(vol=1, price=1, cost=1, p=1), "Optimistic": dict(vol=1.3, price=1.1, cost=0.9, p=1.3)}
def scenario(name, b=B):
    s = SCEN[name]; c = copy.deepcopy(b)
    for k, f in (("m1_prog", s['vol']), ("m1_fee", s['price']), ("m1_opex", s['cost']), ("m1_mlops", s['cost']), ("m3_units", s['vol']), ("m3_price", s['price']),
                 ("m3_opex", s['cost']), ("m2_pdeal", s['p']), ("m2_pmile", s['p']), ("m4_deal", s['price']), ("m4_cost", s['cost'])):
        c = scale(c, k, f)
    c['m4_p'] = [min(1, x * s['p']) for x in c['m4_p']]
    return {k: v['npv'] for k, v in metrics(c).items()}

def tri(rng, lo, mode, hi): return rng.triangular(lo, mode, hi)
def monte_carlo(n=10000, seed=42, b=B):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed); out = {k: [] for k in NAMES}
    for _ in range(n):
        c = copy.deepcopy(b)
        c = scale(c, 'm1_fee', tri(rng, .7, 1, 1.2)); c = scale(c, 'm1_prog', tri(rng, .5, 1, 1.3)); c = scale(c, 'm1_opex', tri(rng, .9, 1, 1.3)); c['hit_rate'] = b['hit_rate']; c['prec'] = float(np.clip(rng.triangular(.6, .78, .9), .3, .95))
        c['r'] = float(rng.triangular(.10, .12, .16))
        c = scale(c, 'm2_pdeal', tri(rng, .4, 1, 1.4)); c = scale(c, 'm2_up', tri(rng, .5, 1, 1.75)); c = scale(c, 'm2_pre', tri(rng, .9, 1, 1.6))
        c = scale(c, 'm3_price', tri(rng, .8, 1, 1.1)); c = scale(c, 'm3_units', tri(rng, .4, 1, 1.3)); c = scale(c, 'm3_opex', tri(rng, .9, 1, 1.3))
        c['kit_lines'] = [x * tri(rng, .8, 1, 1.4) for x in c['kit_lines']]
        c['m4_p'] = [float(np.clip(p * tri(rng, .7, 1, 1.3), 0, 1)) for p in b['m4_p']]; c = scale(c, 'm4_deal', tri(rng, .5, 1, 2)); c = scale(c, 'm4_cost', tri(rng, .9, 1, 1.5))
        m = metrics(c)
        for k in out: out[k].append(m[k]['npv'])
    return {k: np.array(v) for k, v in out.items()}

def mc_stats(arr):
    return dict(mean=float(arr.mean()), median=float(np.median(arr)), p5=float(np.percentile(arr, 5)), p95=float(np.percentile(arr, 95)), prob_pos=float((arr > 0).mean()), sd=float(arr.std()))

Business_Cost_Study.xlsx and business charts

"""Builds Business_Cost_Study.xlsx (live formulas + static risk analysis) and business PNG charts."""
import os, numpy as np
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter as L
from openpyxl.drawing.image import Image
from openpyxl.formatting.rule import ColorScaleRule
import business as bz

F = "Arial"
fn = Font(name=F, size=10); fb = Font(name=F, size=10, bold=True); fi = Font(name=F, size=10, color="0000FF"); fl = Font(name=F, size=10, color="008000")
fh = Font(name=F, size=10, bold=True, color="FFFFFF"); ft = Font(name=F, size=14, bold=True, color="1F3A5F"); fnote = Font(name=F, size=9, italic=True, color="595959"); fred = Font(name=F, size=10, bold=True, color="C00000")
hf = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F3A5F"); yf = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FFFF00")
th = Side(style="thin", color="BFBFBF"); bx = Border(left=th, right=th, top=th, bottom=th); wrap = Alignment(wrap_text=True, vertical="top")
USD = '$#,##0;($#,##0);-'

def put(ws, ref, v, font=fn, fmt=None, fill=None, al=None, border=True):
    c = ws[ref]; c.value = v; c.font = font
    if fmt: c.number_format = fmt
    if fill: c.fill = fill
    if al: c.alignment = al
    if border: c.border = bx
    return c
def hdr(ws, row, vals, col=1):
    for i, v in enumerate(vals): put(ws, f"{L(col+i)}{row}", v, fh, fill=hf, al=Alignment(wrap_text=True, horizontal="center", vertical="center"))
def title(ws, t, sub=None):
    ws["A1"].value = t; ws["A1"].font = ft
    if sub: ws["A2"].value = sub; ws["A2"].font = fnote

def charts(out, mc):
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True); b = bz.B; m = bz.metrics(b); cols = {"M1": "#1F77B4", "M2": "#FF7F0E", "M3": "#2CA02C", "M4": "#D62728"}; paths = {}
    def save(name):
        p = f"{out}/{name}.png"; plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(p, dpi=160); plt.close(); paths[name] = p
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4.5))
    for k, v in m.items(): plt.plot(range(6), np.array(v['cum']) / 1e6, marker="o", color=cols[k], label=f"{k}: {bz.NAMES[k]}")
    plt.axhline(0, color="k", lw=.8); plt.xlabel("Year"); plt.ylabel("Cumulative cash ($M)"); plt.title("Cumulative cash by business model (base case)"); plt.legend(fontsize=7); save("b01_cumulative_cash")
    plt.figure(figsize=(7, 4)); v = [m[k]['npv'] / 1e6 for k in m]; plt.bar(list(m), v, color=[cols[k] for k in m])
    for i, x in enumerate(v): plt.text(i, x, f"{x:.1f}", ha="center", va="bottom" if x >= 0 else "top", fontsize=9)
    plt.axhline(0, color="k", lw=.8); plt.ylabel("NPV ($M)"); plt.title("NPV / rNPV by business model"); save("b02_npv_comparison")
    for k in ("M1", "M3", "M4"):
        base, rows = bz.tornado(k); plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4)); labs = [r[0] for r in rows][::-1]
        lo = [(r[1] - base) / 1e6 for r in rows][::-1]; hi = [(r[2] - base) / 1e6 for r in rows][::-1]
        plt.barh(labs, lo, color="#d95f02", label="-20% input"); plt.barh(labs, hi, color="#1b9e77", label="+20% input")
        plt.axvline(0, color="k", lw=.8); plt.xlabel(f"Change in NPV vs base ${base/1e6:.2f}M"); plt.title(f"Tornado: {bz.NAMES[k]}"); plt.legend(fontsize=8); save(f"b03_tornado_{k}")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(9, 6))
    for a, k in zip(ax.ravel(), mc):
        a.hist(mc[k] / 1e6, bins=40, color=cols[k], alpha=.8); a.axvline(0, color="k", lw=.8); s = bz.mc_stats(mc[k])
        a.set_title(f"{k}: P(NPV>0) = {s['prob_pos']:.0%}, median ${s['median']/1e6:.1f}M", fontsize=9); a.set_xlabel("NPV ($M)")
    plt.suptitle("Monte Carlo NPV distributions (10,000 draws)"); save("b04_montecarlo")
    d = bz.derived(b); fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))
    ax[0].pie(b['kit_lines'], labels=["Gold & reagents", "VD3-PEG", "QC / characterization", "Packaging / cold chain", "Labor"], autopct="%1.0f%%", startangle=90); ax[0].set_title(f"Cost per kit: ${d['c0']}")
    ax[1].bar(["Traditional\nscreening", "AI-guided\nscreening"], [d['trad'] / 1e3, d['cts'] / 1e3], color=["#7f7f7f", "#1F77B4"]); ax[1].set_ylabel("$ thousand per program"); ax[1].set_title("Screening cost per program")
    save("b05_cost_structure")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4)); x = np.arange(0, 21)
    unit = b['m1_fee'] - d['cts']; ax[0].plot(x, (x * unit - (b['m1_opex'][3] + b['m1_mlops'])) / 1e6, color=cols["M1"]); ax[0].axhline(0, color="k", lw=.8)
    ax[0].axvline((b['m1_opex'][3] + b['m1_mlops']) / unit, ls="--", color="gray"); ax[0].set_xlabel("Programs per year"); ax[0].set_ylabel("Annual profit ($M)"); ax[0].set_title("M1 break-even (Year 3 cost base)")
    u = np.linspace(0, 20000, 100); c0 = d['c0'] * (np.maximum(u, b['m3_uref']) / b['m3_uref'])**(np.log(b['m3_lr']) / np.log(2)); cm = b['m3_price'] * (1 - b['m3_sm']) - c0
    ax[1].plot(u, (u * cm - b['m3_opex'][3]) / 1e6, color=cols["M3"]); ax[1].axhline(0, color="k", lw=.8); ax[1].set_xlabel("Kits per year"); ax[1].set_title("M3 break-even (Year 3 opex, learning curve)"); save("b06_breakeven")
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4)); sc = {n: bz.scenario(n) for n in bz.SCEN}; w = .25
    for i, n in enumerate(sc): plt.bar(np.arange(4) + i * w, [sc[n][k] / 1e6 for k in bz.NAMES], w, label=n)
    plt.xticks(np.arange(4) + w, list(bz.NAMES)); plt.axhline(0, color="k", lw=.8); plt.ylabel("NPV ($M)"); plt.title("Scenario analysis"); plt.legend(); save("b07_scenarios")
    return paths

def build(xlsx, chart_dir):
    b = bz.B; d = bz.derived(b); m = bz.metrics(b)
    mc = bz.monte_carlo(); paths = charts(chart_dir, mc)
    wb = Workbook(); AS = {}
    # ---- Assumptions
    wa = wb.active; wa.title = "Assumptions"; title(wa, "Assumptions (blue = editable)", "Illustrative planning values, not sourced quotes. Arrays run Year 0 to Year 5 in columns B-G.")
    hdr(wa, 3, ["Item", "Y0 / value", "Y1", "Y2", "Y3", "Y4", "Y5", "Note"]); r = [4]
    def sec(t): wa[f"A{r[0]}"].value = t; wa[f"A{r[0]}"].font = fb; r[0] += 1
    def row(key, label, val, fmt, note="", lever=False):
        AS[key] = r[0]; put(wa, f"A{r[0]}", label)
        vals = val if isinstance(val, list) else [val]
        for i, v in enumerate(vals):
            c = put(wa, f"{L(2+i)}{r[0]}", v, fi, fmt)
            if lever and i == 0: c.fill = yf
        put(wa, f"H{r[0]}", note, fnote); r[0] += 1
    S = lambda k: f"Assumptions!$B${AS[k]}"; A = lambda k, c: f"Assumptions!{c}{AS[k]}"
    sec("General"); row("r", "Discount rate (M1-M3)", b['r'], "0.0%", "", True)
    sec("Lab cost per formulation tested ($)")
    for i, (n, v) in enumerate(zip(["Synthesis & purification materials", "VD3 ligand & conjugation reagents", "NLS peptide", "Characterization (DLS/TEM/ICP-MS)", "Cell assays", "RNA analysis", "Labor & overhead"], b['cform_lines'])): row(f"cf{i}", n, v, USD)
    for k, l, v, f_ in [("hits", "Validated hits needed per program", b['hits'], "0"), ("mult", "Assay multiplicity (cell lines x runs)", b['mult'], "0"), ("hit_rate", "Empirical hit rate", b['hit_rate'], "0.0%"),
                        ("prec", "AI precision", b['prec'], "0.0%"), ("ovh", "AI overhead factor", b['ovh'], "0.00")]: row(k, l, v, f_)
    sec("Cost per research kit ($)")
    for i, (n, v) in enumerate(zip(["Gold & reagents", "VD3-PEG", "QC / characterization", "Packaging / cold chain", "Labor"], b['kit_lines'])): row(f"kit{i}", n, v, USD)
    sec("Therapeutic COGS per dose"); 
    for k, l, v, f_ in [("gmg", "Gold per dose (mg)", .05, "0.000"), ("gpr", "Gold price ($/g)", 120, "$#,##0"), ("d3", "VD3 ligand ($)", .4, "$0.00"), ("nls", "NLS peptide ($)", 1.8, "$0.00"), ("exc", "Linker/excipients ($)", .6, "$0.00"), ("qc", "Sterile fill & QC ($)", 4.0, "$0.00"), ("ref", "Reference nanocarrier COGS ($)", 35, "$0.00")]: row(k, l, v, f_)
    sec("M1 AI-guided platform service")
    row("m1_prog", "Programs delivered", b['m1_prog'], "0", "", True); row("m1_fee", "Fee per program ($)", b['m1_fee'], USD, "", True); row("m1_opex", "Fixed opex ($)", b['m1_opex'], USD)
    row("m1_mlops", "MLOps / cloud per year ($)", b['m1_mlops'], USD); row("m1_build", "AI model build, Year 0 ($)", b['m1_build'], USD); row("m1_data_n", "Initial training formulations", b['m1_data_n'], "0")
    sec("M2 Out-license of IP (probability-weighted)")
    for k, l, v, f_ in [("m2_ip", "Patent / IP cost, Year 0 ($)", b['m2_ip'], USD), ("m2_bd", "Business-development team per year ($)", b['m2_bd'], USD), ("m2_up", "Upfront payment if deal ($)", b['m2_up'], USD),
                        ("m2_pdeal", "Probability of deal", b['m2_pdeal'], "0%"), ("m2_upyr", "Upfront year", b['m2_upyr'], "0"), ("m2_mile", "Milestone if reached ($)", b['m2_mile'], USD), ("m2_pmile", "Probability milestone paid", b['m2_pmile'], "0%"), ("m2_mileyr", "Milestone year", b['m2_mileyr'], "0")]: row(k, l, v, f_)

Science charts and combined PDF

"""Scientific charts (PNG) and a combined PDF of all charts."""
import glob, os, numpy as np
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.backends.backend_pdf import PdfPages
import matplotlib.image as mpimg
import science as S, transport as T

def build(out):
    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
    def save(name): plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(f"{out}/{name}.png", dpi=160); plt.close()
    plt.figure(figsize=(7.5, 4.2))
    for nls, lab, c in ((0, "Native VD3-GNP (no NLS)", "#7f7f7f"), (1, "VD3-GNP + NLS (proposed)", "#1F77B4")):
        t, o = T.timecourse(nls); plt.plot(t, o[:, 3] * 100, label=lab, color=c)
    plt.xlabel("Time (h)"); plt.ylabel("Dose in nucleus (%)"); plt.title("Nuclear import of the 16.6 nm (TEM) / 34.6 nm (DLS) particle"); plt.legend(); save("01_nuclear_fraction")
    d = [0.038, 0.38, 3.8, 19, 38]; r = T.dose_response(d); plt.figure(figsize=(7, 4))
    for k, c in (("TNBC", "#d62728"), ("ER+", "#1F77B4")): plt.plot(range(5), np.array(r[k]) * 100, marker="o", color=c, label=f"{k} model")
    plt.xticks(range(5), [f"{x} nM" for x in d]); plt.axhline(48.38, ls=":", color="#d62728"); plt.axhline(61.37, ls=":", color="#1F77B4"); plt.ylabel("Predicted invasion reduction (%)")
    plt.title("Dose-response (assumed EC50 10 nM; dotted = observed at 38 nM)"); plt.legend(); save("02_dose_response")
    x = np.arange(8); plt.figure(figsize=(9, 4)); plt.bar(x - .2, np.array(S.capped(S.MDA_RAW)) * 100, .4, label="MDA-MB-231 (TNBC)", color="#d62728"); plt.bar(x + .2, np.array(S.capped(S.MCF_RAW)) * 100, .4, label="MCF-7 (ER+)", color="#1F77B4")
    plt.xticks(x, S.ENDP, rotation=30, ha="right", fontsize=8); plt.ylabel("Reported decrease (%, capped at 95)"); plt.title("Protein decrease after 24 h VD3-GNP (Roy & Hussain 2024)"); plt.legend(); save("03_protein_decrease")
    plt.figure(figsize=(5, 5)); a, b = np.array(S.capped(S.MDA_RAW)) * 100, np.array(S.capped(S.MCF_RAW)) * 100; plt.scatter(a, b)
    for xx, yy, n in zip(a, b, S.ENDP): plt.annotate(n, (xx, yy), fontsize=7)
    plt.xlabel("MDA-MB-231 decrease (%)"); plt.ylabel("MCF-7 decrease (%)"); plt.title(f"Cross-cell-line agreement (r = {np.corrcoef(a, b)[0,1]:.2f})"); save("04_cross_line_scatter")
    rows = S.cohort(); g = {}
    for r_ in rows: g.setdefault((r_['sub'], r_['arm']), []).append((r_['ki1'] - r_['ki0']) / r_['ki0'] * 100)
    plt.figure(figsize=(7, 4.2)); keys = [("ER+", "Placebo"), ("ER+", "VD3-GNP"), ("TNBC", "Placebo"), ("TNBC", "VD3-GNP")]
    bp = plt.boxplot([g[k] for k in keys], labels=[f"{a}\n{b}" for a, b in keys], patch_artist=True)
    for p, c in zip(bp['boxes'], ["#bbbbbb", "#6baed6", "#bbbbbb", "#fb6a4a"]): p.set_facecolor(c)
    plt.axhline(-30, ls="--", color="k", lw=.8); plt.ylabel("Ki-67 % change"); plt.title("Simulated window study: Ki-67 change (dashed = responder threshold)"); save("05_clinical_ki67")
    ols, r2, lo, te, auc, npos = S.analyses(rows); thr = 0.35; y = np.array([t[1] for t in te]); p = np.array([t[2] for t in te]); pr = (p >= thr).astype(int)
    cm = np.array([[((pr == 1) & (y == 1)).sum(), ((pr == 0) & (y == 1)).sum()], [((pr == 1) & (y == 0)).sum(), ((pr == 0) & (y == 0)).sum()]])
    plt.figure(figsize=(4.8, 4.2)); plt.imshow(cm, cmap="Blues")
    for i in range(2):
        for j in range(2): plt.text(j, i, cm[i, j], ha="center", va="center", fontsize=16)
    plt.xticks([0, 1], ["Pred. responder", "Pred. non-resp."], fontsize=8); plt.yticks([0, 1], ["Actual responder", "Actual non-resp."], fontsize=8)
    plt.title(f"Responder classifier (threshold {thr}), AUC {auc:.2f}", fontsize=9); save("06_confusion_matrix")
    imgs = sorted(glob.glob(f"{out}/*.png"))
    with PdfPages(f"{out}/VD3GNP_all_charts.pdf") as pdf:
        for p_ in imgs:
            fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6)); plt.imshow(mpimg.imread(p_)); plt.axis("off"); plt.title(os.path.basename(p_), fontsize=8); pdf.savefig(fig, bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(fig)
